summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model hubs that host and distribute weights (led by Hugging Face, which crossed 3 million public models in August 2026) and developer-facing inference platforms that serve those models via managed APIs. Hugging Face dominates distribution—though downloads are highly concentrated, with the top 200 models accounting for roughly half of all downloads—while platforms like Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow compete on speed, price, and ease of running open models. A notable 2026 trend is the rise of Chinese open-weight labs (Moonshot, MiniMax, Xiaomi, Z.ai, DeepSeek), with China surpassing the U.S. in monthly model downloads.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central hub for hosting, sharing, versioning, and discovering open models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), plus a serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints.
platforms.model_count: ~3 million+ public models (crossed 3M in August 2026, adding ~747K in the first 7.7 months of 2026)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public repos and limited inference; PRO at ~$9/month; Inference Endpoints billed per compute hour; Enterprise Hub at ~$20/user/month; pay-as-you-go inference providers routed through the Hub
features: Largest open model and dataset repository
Git-based repos with LFS for large weights
Transformers, Diffusers, and Datasets libraries
Spaces for hosting demos/apps
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Download stats and model cards for discoverability
Routing to third-party inference providers
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers who need the widest model/dataset selection, open-source tooling, and flexible hosting

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A tool to download, manage, and run open LLMs locally on your own machine with a simple CLI and local API server.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (e.g., Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi), with thousands more importable via GGUF
platforms.pricing: Free and open source (runs on your own hardware); no per-token costs
features: One-command local model download and run
OpenAI-compatible local REST API
GGUF/quantized model support for consumer hardware
Cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows)
Modelfile for custom model configuration
Offline/private inference with no data leaving the device
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally for prototyping, offline use, or self-hosting

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running and deploying open and community models via API, including image, video, audio, and language models packaged as reproducible containers.
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU pricing) or per-run for some models; no subscription required
features: Run thousands of models with a single API call
Cog framework for packaging and publishing custom models
Strong support for image/video/audio generation (e.g., Stable Diffusion, FLUX)
Auto-scaling with scale-to-zero
Fine-tuning for select models
Simple REST and client-library access
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups wanting quick API access to multimodal/generative models without managing infrastructure

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open-source LLMs and multimodal models, plus GPU training infrastructure.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (varies by model size); hourly GPU rental for dedicated endpoints and training; fine-tuning priced by tokens/usage
features: Fast, optimized OpenAI-compatible inference API
Dedicated endpoints and reserved GPU clusters
Fine-tuning and custom model training
Broad catalog of leading open-weight models
Batch inference and serverless options
GPU clusters for large-scale training (Together GPU Clusters)
platforms.best_for: Teams building production LLM apps on open models that need scalable, low-cost inference plus training/fine-tuning

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A speed-optimized inference platform for open-source and fine-tuned LLMs, vision, and audio models with low-latency serving.
platforms.model_count: 100+ curated open models plus custom/fine-tuned model hosting
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference; per-GPU-hour for on-demand dedicated deployments; fine-tuning billed by usage
features: FireAttention engine for very low-latency, high-throughput inference
OpenAI-compatible API
Serverless and dedicated deployment options
LoRA fine-tuning and custom model serving
Function calling, JSON mode, and structured output
Multimodal (vision, audio) model support
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises needing fast, production-grade, cost-efficient inference for open and fine-tuned models

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A developer inference platform (strong in the Chinese/Asian market) offering fast, affordable API access to a broad range of open-source LLMs and multimodal models.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models, with emphasis on leading Chinese open-weight models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, FLUX)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token, generally very competitive/low-cost; free quota for some models; dedicated deployment options
features: OpenAI-compatible API
Strong catalog of Chinese open-weight LLMs and image/video models
Low-latency, cost-optimized inference
Text, image, video, audio, and embedding model support
Serverless and dedicated endpoints
Fine-tuning and batch inference
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asia) wanting low-cost API access to top Chinese and global open-weight models

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An inference platform built on custom LPU hardware delivering extremely high-speed, low-latency serving of open-source LLMs via API.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Mixtral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Whisper)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token, priced competitively; free developer tier with rate limits
features: LPU hardware for industry-leading token throughput
Very low latency inference
OpenAI-compatible API
Speech-to-text (Whisper) support
Simple developer onboarding with free tier
platforms.best_for: Developers prioritizing the fastest possible inference latency for real-time and streaming applications

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway/router that provides access to hundreds of open and closed models from many providers through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models aggregated across dozens of providers (both open and proprietary)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passthrough with a small markup; credits-based billing; some free models available
features: Single API for many model providers
Automatic fallback and provider routing by price/latency
OpenAI-compatible interface
Transparent per-model pricing and usage analytics
Access to both open-weight and frontier closed models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access to many models without managing multiple accounts
